done: Delivered the filtered /registry ledger: a new LedgerTable renders all 56 generated rows with both labeled engine commands and real /components/{name} Docs links over the shared DataTable rich-cell slot, LedgerFilter gained category facets (56/39/11/6) plus a shared-engine TabGroup selector with row-based empty-state detection, the <a href> wrapper around the engine base URLs was dropped (ORI-AST-006 404 fix), engine visibility joins ORI-AST-002's root data-engine contract via CSS, and RED (run_flow --expect red) then GREEN (12 passed, exit 0) were both captured.
concerns: The gate's final `run_flow.py --expect green` must run under CI=1 (reuseExistingServer=false) so Playwright owns the preview lifecycle; without it the flow runner hangs on the open stdout pipe, and a lingering `astro.mjs preview` process — which `pkill -f "astro preview"` does NOT match — causes port-flapping and mid-run connection-refused cascades, so the gate-runner/ORI-CI-004 must own a clean port and the CI=1 flag.

DataTable's cell/row chrome is now `:global(.data-table ...)` (apps/docs/src/components/DataTable.astro:59) because slotted rich rows carry the caller's scope hash, and engine visibility is CSS-driven via `html[data-engine=...] [data-engine-command=...]` (apps/docs/src/components/LedgerTable.astro) — ORI-VIS-004 styling of the ledger table must account for both or it will silently un-style or un-hide cells.
findings: Pre-existing `t.applyToGroup is not a function` TypeError lives in ORI-AST-002's engine-state island: `engineGroups()` (apps/docs/src/scripts/tab-group.ts:98) returns a TS-cast `RnrTabGroup[]` but can include a not-yet-upgraded `rnr-tab-group` under upgrade/soft-nav ordering, so `group.applyToGroup(...)` at apps/docs/src/scripts/tab-group.ts:125 (activate) and :136 (synchronize) throws on pages with >=2 engine groups; I did not reproduce it in my green run but the defect is present and writeProhibited for this task.

scope_impact.found: tab-group.ts cross-group sync calls applyToGroup on every querySelectorAll match without an instanceof/isConnected upgrade guard (apps/docs/src/scripts/tab-group.ts:98-125).
scope_impact.change: ORI-AST-002 should own the fix (guard `engineGroups()` to upgraded RnrTabGroup instances, or the reviewer should cut a fix task) since the file is writeProhibited to ORI-AST-007 and the crash risk lands on any page with InstallCommand + DependencyPanel.

scope_impact.found: The locked flow's green playback flakes under run_flow.py unless CI=1 is set and no stale astro.mjs preview holds 4321.
scope_impact.change: The sprint gate should run the flow with CI=1 and a clean port (see concerns).

scope_impact.found: The ledger table's cell chrome is :global-scoped to `.data-table` and the engine command toggle is pure CSS off `html[data-engine]`.
